natural_input.description: Commercial product introduction for a storage controller. Explain the system relationships with a functional cutaway, not just an exterior cover. Inside the Controller: Host Interface, Command Processor, ECC Engine, Flash Interface. Host and Flash Devices are external. Only these paths: Host -> Host Interface -> Command Processor -> ECC Engine -> Flash Interface -> Flash Devices. This is a logical illustration, not a measured floorplan.
